title: allium sphaerocephalon subsp. ebusitanum
intro: Allium sphaerocephalon subsp. ebusitanum, commonly known as the spherical-headed garlic, is a subspecies of bulbous perennial plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its spherical or egg-shaped flowers and its use in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Allium sphaerocephalon subsp. ebusitanum include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce the risk of infections and alleviate symptoms of various diseases. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protective effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sulfur compounds, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
